summary: The customer called to inquire about an unexpectedly high bill for the current month. The agent verified the account, identified an erroneous extra charge for an additional service, and promised to cancel the service and deduct the amount from the next bill. The call ended cordially with the customer expressing satisfaction.

evidence.text: راح أسجل طلب إلغاء للخدمة وأخصم المبلغ من فاتورتك القادمة فوراً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Register a cancellation request for the extra service and deduct the amount from the customer's next bill immediately.

evidence.text: أهلاً بك في خدمة العملاء، معك أحمد، كيف يمكنني مساعدتك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, introduced themselves professionally, and maintained a respectful tone throughout the call.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك يا أختي، أكيد بنساعدك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent showed immediate empathy and reassurance to the customer regarding her bill concern.

evidence.text: راح أسجل طلب إلغاء للخدمة وأخصم المبلغ من فاتورتك القادمة فوراً.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully identified the issue and provided a clear, actionable resolution by reversing the incorrect charge.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the root cause of the unexpected higher bill in the system.
